name: Rakdos, Lord of Riots
oracle_text:
You can't cast Rakdos unless an opponent lost life this turn.
Flying, trample
Creature spells you cast cost {1} less to cast for each 1 life your opponents have lost this turn.
blocked_sentences: You can't cast Rakdos unless an opponent lost life this turn.
Creature spells you cast cost {1} less to cast for each 1 life your opponents have lost this turn.

needs.what: a card-level casting restriction on the card itself, gated by a condition checked at cast time (here: the sum of life lost this turn by your opponents is greater than 0), applied from hand and the command zone
needs.why_existing_wont_do: card_level_rider_keys only has cant_cast_first_turns (a fixed turn count, no condition); the cant_cast_spells static has affects_spells with no self_only key and its condition can only use static_value_keys, which have no life_lost_this_turn

needs.what: life_lost_this_turn (summed over opponents) as a static_value_keys leaf, so a spell_cost_reduction's amount can be {1} less per 1 life your opponents lost this turn, and a static condition can compare it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: life_lost_this_turn is only in value_keys (effects), not static_value_keys; spell_cost_reduction's amount is read by _static_value, which rejects unknown leaves, and cost_reduction_keys (count/total_power/...) only count objects, not player life ledgers
